name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.208: One lit lamp, for the worker that is working. The cycle marked both directions as
    running when it STARTED, so the Seeder scanned while Download and Upload were already blue from
    the same cycle. Each direction now marks itself when its own run begins and closes its own row,
    start to finish, so exactly one lamp is blue at a time. Also: the upload row counts the skips it
    really keeps (FilesSkipped), so a run that examined files and refused them all says so instead
    of reading as untouched.
